description: A dashboard labelled Live shows numbers typed into the source file. Page views and signups are only printed, the tracking id belongs to nobody, and the figures do not change between reads.

required_outcomes.title: project contains hard-coded demo or sample datasets in production code
required_outcomes.why: demo_data is assigned a literal and is the only source the dashboard reads.

required_outcomes.title: project contains hard-coded demo analytics values in production code
required_outcomes.why: a literal tracking id is configured and no analytics service is loaded, so nothing on the page is measured.

required_outcomes.title: project contains hard-coded demo or chart values in production code
required_outcomes.why: the chart series is a literal array that is identical on every read.

required_outcomes.title: project contains placeholder user or content IDs in production code
required_outcomes.why: signups are attributed to a placeholder user id in a production path.

required_outcomes.title: project contains TODO or FIXME comments in production code
required_outcomes.why: the unfinished analytics wiring is marked with a TODO.

required_outcomes.title: project contains placeholder usage in production code
required_outcomes.why: the signup record is described in the source as a placeholder.
the dashboard's Live label is a claim to a user, so the constants behind it must be surfaced rather than filed away.

forbidden_outcomes.description: The dashboard is reported as showing live or real data, or the project is reported as having working analytics.
The project aggregates to green while the numbers a user reads as live are constants and analytics events go nowhere.

Ordinary constants are flagged as defects. A retry count or a page size is not demo data; what is wrong here is a constant presented as a measurement. crates/sure-core/tests/adversarial_fixture_detection.rs holds this to exactly four demo-data proposals, so a module that flagged every literal would fail rather than pass.
The Live label, the constant figures and the discarded analytics events are not reported at all.

notes: Severity gap, recorded rather than hidden: evaluation/acceptance-manifest.json requires should_fix_first; demo_data_heuristics emits Severity::Note, critical = false, EvidenceClass::Inference, which false_completion_aggregator::aggregate classifies as style_noise rather than material. P6-T004's acceptance names exactly this fixture, so a grader should read the four demo-data detectors firing as the intended evidence. crates/sure-core/tests/adversarial_fixture_detection.rs asserts exactly these six proposals.
